title: Reconsideration reveals shared foundations
meaning: Seeing a whole picture can support revising an explanation after discovery and feeling the value of foundations that become understandable to both people.
text: A shared view can find foundations after a familiar explanation changes. Judgement in the physical position of Ajna suggests reconsidering a version after realisation. The World in energy supports connecting parts within a whole picture. The Hierophant in emotions experiences an understood foundation as significant. You want to see how a particular discovery relates to shared meaning and feel respect for what now supports understanding between you.

Suppose you compare family stories and notice the same word, “help”, referring to different actions. In one story it means advice; in another, simply being present. **Reconsidering one meaning can reveal the footing of a whole picture.** You revise your initial account and connect the word with particular circumstances. Difference becomes understandable without dividing stories into correct and mistaken ones. Each person can explain why an action felt valuable. Your view includes both foundations and preserves differences that give each account its meaning.

The risk is making the discovered foundation obligatory for interpreting every later story. Understanding feels important enough to require one conclusion. Seeking the whole can also reveal an unlike case. Your view retains depth when shared meaning accommodates different circumstances. Respect for a foundation then allows its limits to be considered without devaluing experience you have already understood together.
